2608.20153.title: FormalTCS: Benchmarking End-to-End Frontier Formal Theoretical Computer Science Research of Large Language Models
2608.20153.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown growing potential for automated theoretical computer science (TCS) research, yet existing benchmarks remain far from realistic research settings. We introduce \ourbenchmark, an expert-validated benchmark for evaluating LLMs on frontier, end-to-end TCS research. \ourbenchmark contains $175$ instances drawn from papers accepted to STOC, FOCS, SODA, and COLT in 2025-2026, preserving paper-specific definitions, assumptions, and proof dependencies, with expert-verified Lean formalizations and proofs. Evaluations of leading LLMs reveal that current models remain far from reliably completing the full research pipeline. In particular, autoformalization is the sharpest bottleneck: the best model achieves only $11.5$ on translating natural-language claims into formal theorem statements, compared with $28.6$ Pass@8 when proving human-provided formal statements. Building on \ourbenchmark, we further develop an automated TCS research framework that generates, formalizes, filters, and proves new claims. Of $64$ generated claims, only $6$ ultimately pass expert evaluation and proof verification, indicating that beyond formalization, limited research taste remains another major barrier to autonomous TCS research.
2608.20153.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）在自動化理論計算機科學（TCS）研究中顯示出日益增長的潛力，但現有的基準仍然遠未達到現實研究環境。我們介紹\ourbenchmark，一個經專家驗證的基準，用於評估LLMs在前沿、端到端的TCS研究中的表現。\ourbenchmark包含$175$個實例，來自於2025-2026年被STOC、FOCS、SODA和COLT接受的論文，保留了特定論文的定義、假設和證明依賴，並附有專家驗證的Lean形式化和證明。對領先LLMs的評估顯示，當前模型在可靠地完成整個研究流程方面仍然相距甚遠。特別是，自動形式化是最尖銳的瓶頸：最佳模型在將自然語言主張轉換為正式定理陳述時僅達到$11.5$，相比之下，在證明人類提供的正式陳述時，Pass@8達到$28.6$。基於\ourbenchmark，我們進一步開發了一個自動化的TCS研究框架，該框架生成、形式化、過濾和證明新的主張。在生成的$64$個主張中，最終僅有$6$個通過專家評估和證明驗證，這表明，除了形式化之外，有限的研究品味仍然是自主TCS研究的另一個主要障礙。
